caption: The drawing depicts a full-length, light-colored dress with a fitted bodice, elbow-length sleeves, and a wide, full skirt. The dress features a white or pale background adorned with an all-over pattern of embroidered flowers and foliage in multiple colors: green stems and leaves, blue flowers, and red and pink floral elements arranged vertically along the gown. The neckline and sleeve cuffs are trimmed with lace or a lace-like pattern in white. Surrounding the dress are six small swatches or panels showing detailed embroidery or textile samples. The top left sample features a diagonal striped pattern with small red and green botanical elements. Below it, the middle left sample shows a red fan-like motif, and the bottom left sample shows two green fir trees. On the right side, the top sample has a wavy beige stripe with blue flowers; directly beneath it is a pink abstract motif with floral and animal elements on a beige background; the bottom right panel depicts a blue, dragonfly-like insect with delicate wings. The overall composition uses fine lines and pastel shading in the main dress, accented by the colorful details in both the dress pattern and the sample swatches. The background is plain and uncolored.
title: Dress
